prompt:
Paint ONE place into this tile of a painted grand-strategy map. The input is the finished map around the place, seen straight down; the place stands at the exact CENTRE of the image.

The place: Lễ Tuyền Phái, minor seat. Paint it as a minor sect's seat: a compact walled compound of halls and one tall pagoda or tower, terraces where the land climbs.
How it looks: A low rise on the open grassland by the shore of Triêu Hà Hồ carries a short stack of pale timber halls and a three-roofed pagoda. Below the pagoda a round basin of white stone brims with spring water under one enormous wutong (ngô đồng) tree, its broad leaves always beaded wet. Stoneware jars sealed with red clay stand in rows on the lowest terrace, warming in the sun.
Art brief: A small vertical miniature on flat golden grassland at a lake edge: a three-roofed pagoda over two stepped terraces of pale timber halls with dark grey-green tile roofs, the tallest outline on its plain. At its foot a round white stone spring basin under one huge spreading wutong tree with broad leaves; rows of brown stoneware jars with red clay seals along the lowest terrace; a thin stone channel running from the basin to the lake shore. Warm golden-hour light from the top left, soft shadows to the lower right, glints on the water. No text, no figures larger than specks, nothing outside the footprint.

Rules:
- Paint the place as a small, finely detailed miniature, as if a model-maker had built it into this painted relief: seen from above at a gentle angle so roofs, walls and towers read clearly, its base sitting naturally on the terrain that is there (follow the slopes, the shore, the river).
- Keep it centred and compact: the whole place fits inside a circle about 20 % of the image width across the centre. Short roads or paths may lead out of it.
- Match the map exactly: the same golden-hour light from the TOP LEFT with soft shadows to the bottom right, the same painterly style, colours and level of detail as the surrounding terrain; the building scale fits the trees and hills around it.
- Leave everything outside that central circle exactly as it is in the input.
- Never: text, labels, banners with writing, flags with symbols, people larger than specks, a frame, a vignette, clouds over the place.
